# Operations Service Standards and Efficiency Guidelines

This document details critical operational tasks and standards:

*   Investigate teller performance urgently.
*   Optimize branch efficiency urgently.
*   Optimize cash flow based on audit findings.
*   Review teller performance urgently.
*   Update cash flow quarterly.
